_meta.name: Ghana Agricultural Export Navigator - Products Database
_meta.legend: HS codes are INDICATIVE and must be confirmed with your clearing agent or the Ghana Revenue Authority tariff. All specifics marked with confirm flags must be verified with the named agency before a live shipment.

fresh_plant.name: Fresh agricultural / plant produce
fresh_plant.storage: Licensed packhouse/storage facility (FDA requires the storage facility supplying fresh produce to be licensed)
fresh_plant.chain: Farm, Packhouse, PPRSD inspection, FDA permit, Customs (ICUMS), Port/Airport, Shipment, Destination

processed.name: Processed / prepackaged food
processed.storage: Appropriate warehouse; FDA processing/licensing requirements apply to the facility
processed.chain: Production, Quality control, Pack, FDA compliance, Permit, Customs (ICUMS), Port/Airport, Shipment, Destination

animal.name: Live animals / animal products
animal.storage: Appropriate holding/cold facilities per VSD and FDA requirements
animal.chain: Producer, VSD inspection/testing, Certificates, Customs (ICUMS), Port/Airport, Shipment, Destination veterinary checks

fish.name: Fish / fishery products
regulators: GSA Fish Inspection (exporter registration, approved establishments, consignment inspection)
fish.storage: Approved cold store required for EU-oriented exports; ice plants/landing sites inspected by GSA
fish.chain: Landing site, Approved processing plant, GSA inspection, FDA clearance, Customs (ICUMS), Port/Airport, Reefer shipment, Destination

tree_crop.name: Tree crops (TCDA-regulated)
regulators: TCDA (registration, licensing, EXPORT PERMIT - mandatory since 1 Apr 2026)
tree_crop.storage: TCDA exporter requirements can include warehousing capacity - confirm your category requirements
tree_crop.chain: Farm, Processing (if any), TCDA permit, PPRSD/FDA as applicable, Customs (ICUMS), Port/Airport, Shipment, Destination

cocoa.name: Cocoa
cocoa.chain: Farm, Licensed buying, COCOBOD quality system, Customs, Port, Shipment, Destination

special.name: Special products (honey, seeds, organic, wildlife-related)
regulators: Depends on the product form: FDA for food products, VSD for animal-origin items, PPRSD for seeds/plants
coreCerts: Varies by product - the roadmap lists your category basics and flags what to confirm
special.chain: Producer, Product regulator, Certificates, Customs, Port/Airport, Shipment, Destination

products.name: Pineapple

forms.name: Fresh pineapple
forms.note: Main fresh-fruit pathway: PPRSD + FDA fresh-produce guideline

forms.name: Pineapple juice (processed)
forms.note: Switches to the processed/prepackaged-food pathway - FDA requirements become much more extensive

forms.name: Fruit pulp (processed)
forms.note: Processed-food pathway

packaging: Supplier information and country of supply
products.temperature: Cool chain required for sea freight (reefer); confirm exact set-point with your buyer and shipper

example.note: Worked example: revenue US$1,200 - costs US$950 = US$250 profit (20.83% margin). If costs rise to US$1,150 the same crop earns only US$50 (4.17%). Use the calculator with YOUR real numbers.

destinationNotes.uk: UK plant-health requirements + UK marketing standards; confirm current rules on gov.uk before contracting
destinationNotes.eu: EU marketing standards for fresh fruit/vegetables + EU pesticide MRLs; confirm on EU official systems
destinationNotes.usa: APHIS plant-health conditions + US FDA food rules; confirm before contracting
destinationNotes.uae: UAE plant-quarantine + food-safety rules; confirm before contracting

products.name: Pepper (chili)

forms.name: Fresh pepper
forms.note: PPRSD + FDA fresh-produce pathway

forms.name: Dried pepper
forms.note: Treated as processed food - FDA prepackaged-foods pathway + GSA where applicable

forms.name: Ground spice
forms.note: Processed-food pathway: FDA registration + labelling; GSA standards may apply

certificates: Certificate of analysis where buyer requires
packaging: For spice: ingredient labelling per destination rules
products.temperature: Cool chain for fresh; ambient for dried forms
transport: Air for fresh premium or small lots
rejectionReasons: Moisture too high in dried lots

example.note: Indicative only - dried premium grades can earn far more. Calculate YOUR numbers.

destinationNotes.uk: Confirm UK pesticide-MRL compliance before planting - residues are a top rejection cause
destinationNotes.eu: EU MRLs are strict; confirm current increased-control lists that may apply to vegetables from Ghana

products.name: Okra

forms.name: Fresh okra
forms.note: PPRSD + FDA fresh-produce pathway

forms.name: Dried okra
forms.note: Processed-food pathway

packaging: Ventilated packaging appropriate for the crop
storage: Cool room - okra is highly perishable
products.temperature: Cool chain strongly recommended; confirm set-point with buyer
transport: Air freight is common for fresh okra to Europe due to short shelf life
ports: Tema Port (only if buyer accepts sea transit)

example.note: Indicative only. Air freight eats margins on light, bulky crops - always calculate break-even.

destinationNotes.eu: EU MRL compliance is critical for okra; check current EU increased-control lists for produce from Ghana

products.name: Garden eggs

forms.name: Fresh garden eggs
forms.note: PPRSD + FDA fresh-produce pathway

products.temperature: Cool chain recommended; confirm with buyer
transport: Air freight typical for small premium lots

destinationNotes.eu: Check EU controls for solanaceous produce from Ghana

products.name: Cassava
products.formsNote: Cassava is several different export products - the FORM changes the regulatory path. Choose carefully.

forms.name: Fresh cassava
forms.note: Plant-health/food-safety pathway (PPRSD + FDA fresh produce)

forms.name: Dried cassava / cassava chips
forms.note: Processed agricultural product - FDA processed pathway; moisture/quality specs matter

forms.name: Gari
forms.note: Processed food - FDA prepackaged-foods pathway + labelling

forms.name: Cassava flour
forms.note: Processed/prepackaged food - FDA registration + GSA standards where applicable

forms.name: Cassava starch
forms.note: Industrial/food ingredient - FDA + GSA + destination rules

forms.name: Cassava-based animal feed
forms.note: Potentially different regulatory requirements - confirm with FDA/GSA and destination

certificates: Certificate of analysis for flour/starch where buyer requires
packaging: For processed forms: full ingredient/prepackaged labelling per destination
For fresh: supplier info, country of supply, handling instructions
storage: Ventilated dry storage (fresh cassava is perishable - process quickly)
products.temperature: Ambient for processed; minimal shelf life for fresh
transport: Fresh cassava rarely travels far - ECOWAS regional routes common
rejectionReasons: Wrong HS classification causing customs delay

example.note: Indicative - low unit prices mean volume and cost control decide profit.

destinationNotes.eu: EU rules per form; starch/flour face food-additive/ingredient rules
destinationNotes.ecowas: Regional market is the natural first step for many cassava forms

products.name: Coconut
products.tcdaNote: TCDA PERMIT REQUIRED: from 1 April 2026, exporting coconut (processed or unprocessed) requires a valid written TCDA permit. Register with TCDA first.

forms.name: Fresh coconut
forms.note: TCDA permit + PPRSD pathway

forms.name: Coconut water (packaged)
forms.note: TCDA permit + FDA prepackaged-foods pathway

forms.name: Virgin coconut oil
forms.note: TCDA permit + FDA processed-food pathway + labelling

forms.name: Desiccated coconut
forms.note: TCDA permit + FDA processed-food pathway

forms.name: Copra (dried kernel)
forms.note: TCDA permit; industrial buyer pathway

packaging: For food forms: full labelling per destination (ingredients, net weight, batch, best-before)
For fresh: supplier info, country of supply, net weight, batch, handling
products.temperature: Ambient for most forms; confirm for packaged water/oil
transport: Air possible for premium packaged products

example.note: Indicative - value addition (oil/desiccated) usually earns more than raw copra.

destinationNotes.china: GACC registration may be required - verify BEFORE contracting

products.name: Mango
products.tcdaNote: TCDA PERMIT REQUIRED (1 April 2026 rule covers mango) - plus fresh-fruit regulators.

forms.name: Fresh mango
forms.note: TCDA permit + PPRSD + FDA fresh-produce pathway

forms.name: Dried mango
forms.note: TCDA permit + FDA processed-food pathway

forms.name: Mango pulp/puree
forms.note: TCDA permit + FDA processed-food pathway

storage: Licensed packhouse with hot-water treatment capability where destinations require
products.temperature: Cold chain essential for fresh (approx. 12-13C typical - confirm with buyer)
transport: Sea reefer for volume (about 20-25 days to Europe)

example.note: Indicative. TCDA also announced a 2026 minimum producer price for fresh mango at GHS 5.22/kg (major season) - TCDA.gov.gh.

destinationNotes.eu: EU MRLs + marketing standards; some origins face increased controls - check
destinationNotes.usa: APHIS treatment protocols may apply - confirm

products.name: Honey

forms.name: Bottled/processed honey
forms.note: Food pathway: FDA prepackaged-foods requirements + labelling

forms.name: Raw/comb honey
forms.note: Still food - food-safety pathway; check destination rules

forms.name: Beeswax
forms.note: Non-food product - confirm the applicable authority and destination rules

forms.name: Propolis / royal jelly
forms.note: Health-product-like - confirm the applicable authority and destination rules

forms.name: Live bees
forms.note: Special examination required - VSD/PPRSD and destination rules; do not ship without confirmation

certificates: Certificate of analysis (quality/residues) where buyer requires
packaging: Full food labelling for bottled honey (ingredients, net weight, batch, best-before, producer details)
storage: Avoid heat - honey can ferment/expand in transit heat
rejectionReasons: Residues above limits (antibiotics are a classic honey rejection cause)

example.note: Indicative - premium grades and certifications earn more.

destinationNotes.uk: UK honey compositional standards + residue rules
destinationNotes.eu: EU honey directives + strict residue testing

products.name: Eggs

forms.name: Table eggs
forms.note: VSD + food-safety pathway; destinations impose strict poultry-disease controls

forms.name: Hatching/fertile eggs
forms.note: Strict veterinary pathway - import permits and health rules

storage: Maintain cold chain; eggs are fragile and perishable
transport: Air freight strongly preferred (short shelf life)

example.note: Price per egg/crate varies - model with your real numbers.

destinationNotes.uk: Strict animal-product import rules - confirm Ghana eligibility first
destinationNotes.ecowas: Regional trade is often the practical first market

products.name: Poultry (live birds & chicken meat)

forms.name: Live chickens
forms.note: VSD full pathway: inspection, vaccination, testing, quarantine, approved transport

forms.name: Frozen chicken meat
forms.note: VSD + FDA frozen-meat guideline + destination approvals

packaging: For meat: full food labelling, net weight, batch, storage temperature
For live: approved crates/transport conditions per VSD
products.temperature: Frozen chain for meat (-18C typical - confirm); welfare conditions for live birds
transport: Sea reefer or air for frozen meat

destinationNotes.uk: Strict animal-product rules - confirm eligibility BEFORE investing
destinationNotes.eu: Approved-establishment requirement - the establishment itself must be EU-listed

products.name: Meat (cattle, goats, sheep, pork)

forms.name: Chilled meat
forms.note: VSD + destination veterinary rules; short shelf life

forms.name: Frozen meat
forms.note: VSD + FDA frozen-meat guideline + destination approvals

forms.name: Processed meat products
forms.note: FDA prepackaged-foods pathway + destination rules

packaging: Full food labelling (product, net weight, batch, storage temperature, producer)
storage: Cold chain maintained end to end

destinationNotes.uk: Confirm eligibility - many destinations restrict meat origins

products.name: Fish & fishery products

forms.name: Fresh/chilled fish
forms.note: GSA Fish Inspection + FDA + catch documentation

forms.name: Frozen fish/shellfish
forms.note: GSA approved establishments + FDA frozen guideline

forms.name: Smoked fish
forms.note: Processed fish pathway - food-safety rules + destination rules

forms.name: Dried fish
forms.note: Processed pathway; moisture/packaging critical

certificates: GSA health certificate (EU Competent Authority system)
storage: Approved cold store (required for EU-oriented exports)
Ice plants/landing sites inspected by GSA

destinationNotes.eu: Establishment must be on the EU-approved list - the FACILITY is regulated, not just the fish. Work with GSA Fish Inspection from day one
destinationNotes.china: GACC establishment registration required - verify BEFORE contracting
